title: circle-back hook freezes the session for the whole delay (blocking sleep in Stop hook)
description: Stop hooks run synchronously - Claude Code waits for them. circle-back.sh calls 'sleep $DELAY' inline, so the session is frozen and unusable for the entire delay. Observed: /circle-back 1800 locked a session at 'running stop hooks 2/4' for 7+ minutes before being killed. Live tests 4.1-4.5 all used 3-20s delays, so the freeze was under 20s and read as normal latency - the test plan never exercised a long delay, which is the whole point of the feature. Hook unregistered from settings.json and queues cleared as mitigation.
acceptance_criteria: Hook never sleeps; stores absolute due-time and exits 0 silently when not yet due, so the session stays interactive. A long delay is verified to leave the session usable.
